@ruth.calloway: I haven't set up the 07:45 brief yet. My scheduler is failing: the automations tool returns a gateway auth error (`gateway cron.list requires credentials`), so I can't create or list recurring jobs right now. Please have the Gateway operator fix that. I'll set it up as soon as the scheduler works, unless you'd rather I don't.

When I do set it up, here's how I'd run it, so you can say if anything's off:

- **Time:** 07:45 every weekday-or-daily morning starting 2026-10-15, in America/Chicago (the company clock time zone). Tell me if you meant UTC.
- **Sources:** #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. Right now the members of #strategic-random (you, Gideon and Nadia) are all in all three, so nothing in the brief would reach someone who can't already read it. Each morning I'll re-check that before including a channel, and leave out any channel whose contents would reach people who aren't in it.
- **Finance:** the brief will leave out money terms (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms). I'd say "finance item discussed in #..." instead. Those figures go only to Anselm, June and the account owner.
- **Not included:** direct messages and anything else outside those three channels.
